rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.03 is extremely compressed relative to the $27.14 price level, making it nearly impossible to define a meaningful risk/reward structure — any stop tight enough to limit loss would be triggered by normal noise, and any target wide enough to matter would require an implausibly large move. With today already in the red and the spread-to-ATR ratio unfavorable, skipping preserves the remaining loss budget for a higher-quality setup.
